mechanism_narrative: A positive year-over-year growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the quarters where GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls to or below 0.25%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.25.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.5%) combined with declining payroll employment (PAYEMS growth < 0% over the past month) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where UNRATE > 9.5% and PAYEMS growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary macro regime, a decline in housing starts below 600,000 units (HOUST < 600) signals continued economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST < 600 and the economy is in recession.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) signals deflationary pressure, which is associated with economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the months where CPIAUCSL declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 (INDPRO < 95) signals a severe contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low housing starts (HOUST < 600) and low real personal consumption (RSAFS < 340000 million dollars) signals a broad-based economic weakness in the consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 340000.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.5% (UNRATE > 9.5), it signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where UNRATE > 9.5.
